name: Transportation Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public transportation data.

entries.title: NTSB Aviation Accident Database
entries.description: The National Transportation Safety Board's database of civil aviation accidents and selected incidents in the United States, its territories, and international waters since 1962, including foreign investigations the NTSB took part in.

coverage.spatial: United States, territories and possessions, and international waters

entries.attribution: National Transportation Safety Board, Aviation Accident Database
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page says "The NTSB aviation accident database contains civil aviation accidents and selected incidents that occurred from 1962 to present within the United States, its territories and possessions, and in international waters." NTSB's newer CAROL search lives at data.ntsb.gov, which redirects to my.ntsb.gov/basic. The download formats are assumed from NTSB's usual distribution and weren't checked. Records are added as investigations progress, so cadence is event.

entries.title: UNCTADstat
entries.description: UN Trade and Development's statistical database covering maritime transport, merchant fleets, liner shipping connectivity, and freight volumes alongside its broader trade and economy indicators.
entries.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). ITF-OECD (International Transport Forum), the other natural international transport-statistics body, returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge on direct fetch — same block class as almanac-template#2. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
